description:
**File**: `src/fetcher/refresh_supervisor.cr:251`

**Severity**: P2 (config retention + memory leak after reload)

`run_timed_refresh` captures `config_snapshot = @state.active_config`
into the closure of a `tracked_spawn("refresh_worker")` block. The
worker fiber then runs `RefreshLoop.refresh_all(config_snapshot, ...)`
holding the entire `Config` struct (with clustering settings,
feeds.yml content, theme configs, etc.) by closure capture until it
exits.

If the config is reloaded mid-cycle (via `reload_config_if_changed`),
the worker fiber still holds the OLD config. Worse: the closure
prevents the GC from reclaiming the old config until the worker
fiber exits, which can be up to `FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS × retries`
later.

**Fix sketch**:
1. Pass `config_snapshot` to `refresh_all` as an explicit parameter
   (already does — `RefreshLoop.refresh_all(config_snapshot, ...)`)
2. The closure then only captures references that are already
   declared as method-local variables, not the entire Config
3. Or: extract just the fields the worker actually needs and pass
   those

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §2.3.
title: Worker fiber captures config_snapshot by closure in run_timed_refresh
